VERDICT: FAIL

BASIS: WIT

The third-party reviewer note (WIT class evidence) explicitly identifies that structured audit logging is absent, contradicting the self-report claim that all three features were implemented. While the CI log (ATT class) confirms tests pass, it does not verify the presence of audit logging functionality—only that test cases executed successfully. The witness testimony of the independent reviewer directly contradicts completeness of acceptance criteria (C).
